rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for physically using a chisel or working material with one.

example.english: I chisel a groove into the piece of wood.
example.traditional: 我用鑿喺塊木頭上鑿條坑。
example.jyutping: ngo5 jung6 zok6 hai2 faai3 muk6 tau4 soeng6 zok6 tiu4 haang1

rows.note: Use this for gradually weakening or eroding something through small changes over time.

example.english: These small changes gradually chisel away at the team's morale.
example.traditional: 呢啲小改動逐步削弱咗團隊嘅士氣。
example.jyutping: ni1 di1 siu2 goi2 dung6 zuk6 bou6 soek3 joek6 zo2 tyun4 deoi2 ge3 si6 hei3

rows.note: Use this when someone obtains money from another person by deception or pressure.

example.english: That company is always trying to chisel people out of their money: it takes payment and then does no work.
example.traditional: 嗰間公司成日呃錢，收咗錢又唔做嘢。
example.jyutping: go2 gaan1 gung1 si1 seng4 jat6 ngaak1 cin2 sau1 zo2 cin2 jau6 m4 zou6 je5
